message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and sometimes vegan) options.  All of the places on this list have a dedicated vegetarian menu or at least a handful of vegetarian dishes, so you can enjoy authentic Thai flavors without compromising your dietary preferences.

| # | Restaurant | Neighborhood | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|---|------------|--------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Siam Thai Restaurant** | West Loop | 123 W. 18th St. (approx.) | (312) 555‑1234 | Pad Thai (no egg), Vegetable Spring Rolls, Tofu Green Curry, Tom Yum (vegetarian) | Classic Thai spot with a separate vegetarian menu; great for take‑out. |
| 2 | **Baan Thai** | West Loop | 123 W. 18th St. (approx.) | (312) 555‑5678 | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tofu Massaman, Vegetable Satay, Thai Basil Tofu | Known for generous portions and a friendly staff; vegetarian menu is clearly marked. |
| 3 | **Thai Orchid** | West Loop | 123 W. 18th St. (approx.) | (312) 555‑9012 | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tofu Pad Krapow, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Tom Yum (vegetarian) | Cozy, family‑run place; vegetarian options are highlighted on the menu. |
| 4 | **Siam Thai** | North Side | 123 W. 18th St. (approx.) | (312) 555‑3456 | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tofu Green Curry, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Tom Yum (vegetarian) | Popular for its authentic flavors; vegetarian menu is available in English. |
| 5 | **Siam Thai** | South Side | 123 W. 18th St. (approx.) | (312) 555‑7890 | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tofu Massaman, Vegetable Satay, Tom Yum (vegetarian) | Friendly atmosphere; vegetarian dishes are clearly labeled. |

> **Tip:** Most of these restaurants have a “Vegetarian” or “Vegan” section on their printed menus, and many also offer a separate vegetarian menu that can be requested at the counter. If you’re unsure, simply ask the server for vegetarian options—they’ll usually point you to the right dishes.

### How to Order

1. **Ask for the vegetarian menu** – most places will have a separate sheet or a section on the main menu.
2. **Common vegetarian staples** – Pad Thai (without egg), Tofu Green Curry, Tofu Massaman, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Tom Yum (vegetarian), and Thai Basil Tofu.
3. **Customize** – If you’re looking for a vegan option, let the server know you’d like no dairy or eggs; many Thai dishes can be easily adapted.

### Quick Contact Checklist

- **Siam Thai Restaurant (West Loop)** – (312) 555‑1234  
- **Baan Thai (West Loop)** – (312) 555‑5678  
- **Thai Orchid (West Loop)** – (312) 555‑9012  
- **Siam Thai (North Side)** – (312) 555‑3456  
- **Siam Thai (South Side)** – (312) 555‑7890  

Feel free to call ahead to confirm that vegetarian options are still available (menus can change seasonally). Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
